sponsorships for the event started in September. The sponsoring entities spent a collective $18,000 on Everybody’s Formal.
Sistrunk said she’s attended Everybody’s Formal for the last two years.
At the November ASB Executive Council meeting, Miller stated his goal to secure sufficient sponsorship funds for Everybody’s Formal “administered funds,” which he defines as the cash available for ASB-sponsored events. ASB assigns various budget types to support student organizations in hosting events. If ASB gathers sufficient allocated funds for the upcoming events, Miller said they can afford to fail quickly.
ASB’s target for fundraising was the goal Morgan left for the organization. Morgan left in August.
ASB President Elam Miller aimed for 30 formal commitments last year and noted that he would be satisfied if ASB achieved its goals.
During her meeting with the present ASB director, Morgan mentioned that she giggles as they discuss three to four years ahead about the precise state of the organization at that time.
Mullins is the president of Ole Miss’ Beta Theta Pi fraternity.
Mullins, the ASB President during the 2013-14 school year, stated that the aim is to get everyone who wants to go to Everybody’s Formal to come.
Greg Miner, who serves as Special Projects coordinator in Student Affairs, is a member of Kappa Sigma. He is considered for the potential future ASB director role at Everybody’s Formal, as per Athletic Director Keith Carter’s recommendation letter including Miller. He stated he was hired for a special projects coordinator role in Student Affairs, focusing on recruiting millennial and older "menthol stroke" students.
Mullins stated that incoming students ought to take full advantage of ASB’s events, including Everybody’s Formal, Geeks Prom, Speak Freely, and IMPULSE.
Miner expressed his excitement about working remotely for the University to ensure smooth operations for incoming, transfer, and non-traditional students.
